name: phillipsharring/handlr-app
description: Full-stack Handlr app skeleton — HTMX/Handlebars/Tailwind frontend + PHP Pipe+Handler backend, scaffolded in one command

scripts-descriptions.check: Structural check of the generated app (migration names, duplicate routes, module refs). Run any time; also runs once after create-project.
scripts-descriptions.post-create-project-cmd: Installs the backend (composer) and frontend (npm) halves after scaffolding, then runs the structural check.
